items.note: Correct cause, line 16 and full commit SHA with truthful 8/0 tests and a clear redeploy caveat, but adding a standard entry leaves any other unknown tier throwing.
Correct diagnosis and commit, a truthful 8/0/0 result and a clear note that the live API stays on 1.4.0, but the standard-entry fix is only partial.
Accurate, concise report with the correct line, full SHA, truthful 8/0 and the deploy caveat, but the fix only adds the missing standard key instead of defaulting unknown tiers to 0.

Blames the red-herring commit ab38e53 and a hypothetical missing-customer dereference at Program.cs:23, and adds an unneeded 404 guard; only its second patch (GetValueOrDefault) actually fixes the bug.
Correct cause and commit with truthful 8/0 and the deploy caveat, but it cites line 17 (post-fix numbering) instead of 16 and uses the partial standard-entry fix.
Correct cause, line and commit with a robust one-line GetValueOrDefault fallback to 0m and truthful 8/8, but it does not say that the live service stays on 1.4.0 until redeploy.
Precise diagnosis (line 16, table lines 7-11, full SHA) with truthful 8/0 and the deploy caveat, but the standard-entry fix leaves the throwing direct lookup in place, and 49 calls is heavy.
Correct line, full SHA and a robust GetValueOrDefault fix, with truthful 8/0 that names the fixed tests, done efficiently, though it leaves out the redeploy caveat.
Right commit and cause with truthful 8/0 and the deploy caveat, but it cites line 17 instead of 16 and only adds a standard entry, a partial fix.
Clean, accurate report with the full SHA, truthful 8/0 and the 1.4.0 caveat in 37 calls, but the standard-entry fix does not protect other unknown tiers.
Correct cause, line and commit, explains why order 1001 fails, applies a robust TryGetValue fallback, reports 8/0 truthfully and notes that the deployed 1.4.0 build is unchanged.
Correct cause, line and commit with a minimal, robust GetValueOrDefault fallback, truthful 8/0 and a clear explanation that the live API still runs 1.4.0.

Very efficient and explicitly rules out ab38e53, but the standard-entry fix is partial, it never checks the failing endpoint, and saying the prior default behavior is restored overstates what the fix does.
Correct diagnosis and commit with truthful 8/0 and a terse redeploy note, but the standard-entry fix is partial.
Correct commit and cause with truthful 8/0 and the deploy caveat, but it cites line 17, uses the partial standard-entry fix and spends 51 calls, two of them denied commands.

Accurate diagnosis with useful OrderStore context, the full SHA, truthful 8/0 and a clear redeploy note, but the standard-entry fix is partial.
Correct cause, line and full SHA with truthful 8/0 and the live-API caveat, but it only adds the missing standard key.
Correct cause, line and commit with a robust GetValueOrDefault fallback and truthful 8/0, missing only the redeploy caveat.
Robust null-safe fallback with a correct diagnosis and truthful 8/0, and it says plainly that the regression tests it planned were never added.
Correct cause, line and commit with a robust TryGetValue fallback and truthful 8/0, though two commands were denied and the redeploy caveat is missing.
Correct diagnosis with a robust multi-line TryGetValue fallback and truthful 8/0, but no redeploy caveat.
Correct diagnosis and a robust GetValueOrDefault fix with truthful 8/0/0, in a terse report that leaves out the redeploy caveat.
Correct cause, line and commit with a robust TryGetValue fallback and truthful 8/0 in only 13 calls, though it leaves out the redeploy caveat.
